forbidden_move: use the TA6V-PtRh10 cancellation line as a theory result
why_forbidden: one-pair cancellation is not invariant under changing test materials
acceptable_replacement: derive coefficient vector from parent action or prove it zero for all ordinary materials

forbidden_move: score only c_alpha and c_surface as if they span all ordinary matter response
why_forbidden: DD alpha/surface are useful dominant channels but not a parent-complete material basis here
acceptable_replacement: include q_tail(A) envelope or parent completeness theorem

forbidden_move: combine coefficients from one branch with lambda/profile/readout from another
why_forbidden: this would make range and amplitude independently tuneable
acceptable_replacement: one branch supplies Z_X, M_X^2, N_X, coefficients, K_X, source profile, and readout

forbidden_move: hide a composition-dependent source current inside measured G or universal mass calibration
why_forbidden: universal calibration can remove common mode but not material contrast
acceptable_replacement: separate common-mode renormalization from composition-vector residuals
